notes: Broader Qwen3-8B full-cache dev pilot: all 19 AppWorld data 0.2.0 dev task families, choosing variant _1 by identifier without inspecting its outcomes, with replicate seeds 17 and 18. This gives 38 sequential fresh attempts. Inherits the candidate baseline prompt and existing 600-second budget per task/seed, 40 GiB peak VRAM cap, 32768-token context, 4096-token generation limit, BF16, full KV without eviction, and no recovery. Each replicate has N=1; pooling the two seeds is not budget-matched best-of-2. The three targeted prompt-development tasks remain included and must be identified in analysis.
